description: Map which jobs or tests can safely run in parallel: dependency levels, the critical path, sequential vs parallel time, and a worker schedule when a worker count is given.

jobs.description: Jobs or tests in the workload (at least one)

depends_on.description: Names of jobs that must finish before this job starts; jobs not related by dependency can run in parallel (optional, default [])

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the job in seconds (finite, >= 0)

workers.description: Number of parallel workers for the greedy schedule (optional; when omitted the schedule is empty and the makespan is the unbounded parallel time)

name: map_parallelization
